title: My first AI game! A Sapphic Visual Novel available for FREE.
author: CanadianWinter20
selftext:
Hello! I'm pretty excited. I am amazed that the technology exists where people who do not know how to code can share their ideas and the AI can become the development studio. The only limit is your ingenuity, creativity, drive, and patience. Your own personal stories can now be shared in this new medium. Your ideas don't need to only exist in your head anymore. This game was designed entirely within the makeplay website through several prompts. 

It's a story of two high school seniors (18) who are close friends and want to become more. You create memories and moments together which follow you towards the 5 different endings. The content itself is SFW. More features and activities will be added in the future. 

I'd love to know what you think and any feedback is appreciated. This technology is amazing. It's giving me fond memories of high school. Days which we will never get back. Except with this technology it is now possible.

p.s. if anyone has ideas or suggestions please let me know!

  
I am trying to brainstorm more sophisticated projects and wish to explore evolutions of existing genres. 

[Room for Forever (Lesbian) · MakePlay](https://makeplay.ai/p/jduupjzys9)

comments.author: Fun_Score5537
comments.body:
I'm not in the market for lesbian love stories but by looking at the artwork, I can immediately tell you that you need other tools for your art-style. This AI-generated "pixel art" looks absolutely awful. 

Try this: [https://github.com/Retro-Diffusion/pixel-art-fixer](https://github.com/Retro-Diffusion/pixel-art-fixer)

comments.author: KS-Wolf-1978
comments.body:
Do yourself a favor and use some software that converts your fake pixel art into proper pixels.

When pixels are not exactly the same shape and size, it becomes ugly like this.

As you can infer from the number in my nickname - in my childhood i enjoyed the big pixels, both the rounded ones that glow and the ones that are perfect squares.

replies.author: CanadianWinter20
replies.body:
i will check it out. this is my first attempt at a game and i didn't expect it to turn out as well as it did. the software has exceeded my expectations. my other game right now uses full hd assets but it is not a visual novel. it's an arkanoid/breakout game. i am tinkering with that and trying to brainstorm this and other potential projects. i might rework all the art assets in this visual novel in the future. i already did that before actually. look at how the ai originally created the characters for their selfies. pretty bad.  i reworked those and maybe reworking all the backgrounds will be ideal too.  but they do have a pleasing retro pixel aesthetic so i will consider giving players the option.

replies.author: KS-Wolf-1978
replies.body:
Which model are you using for these ?

Any flavor of Illustrious would do much better, people seem to like Anima the best currently.

You can reimagine these with any model using controlnet canny, or use an edit model like Flux Klein 2, or Qwen Image Edit 2511 with simple prompt "improve the image".

replies.author: KS-Wolf-1978
replies.body:
Example for the template Klein Edit workflow in ComfyUI with your bottom right image and prompt:

"make this purikura image of two anime girls better quality and upscale, the girl on the left is kissing the girl on the right on the cheek, shiny reflection in her dark gray eyes, preserve poses and colors, white background, high quality anime screenshot"
